findings.defect: The whispered identification names Kkeokjeong; the draft makes it a generic hyung.
findings.rationale: In the dust he first calls that specific person, then, getting no answer, asks who it is. Dropping the name erases that identification step.

findings.defect: Teammates address him as 꺽정 형님; the nickname is omitted.
findings.rationale: The established address is Kkeokjeong hyung. Generic Hyung loses that intimacy and who is being named.

findings.correction: The greatsword split my waist right through, iron spear and all—
findings.current: The greatsword should have split my waist clean in two, iron spear and all—
findings.defect: The source states the cut as a completed action, then cuts off; should have telegraphs that it failed.
findings.rationale: The fake-out depends on narrating the waist being split, then revealing spear and waist are unharmed.
findings.source: 대검은 철창과 함께 내 허리를 그대로 갈라 버렸…….

findings.defect: 전승(傳承) is inheritance/transmission, and 됩니다 is present-declarative, not a completed transfer.
findings.rationale: After Synchronization complete, the System announces that every system is being inherited, not that a transfer already finished.

findings.correction: My nose wasn’t the only thing getting broken. The back of my head was, too.
findings.current: My nose wasn’t the only thing getting broken. My skull was, too.
findings.defect: 뒤통수 is the back of the head, the other side from the nose in the extended idiom.
findings.rationale: The joke is nose and occiput both broken, not a generic skull injury.
findings.source: 이건 코도 깨지고 뒤통수도 깨진 거다.

findings.correction: Im Kkeokjeong flew about ten meters
findings.current: Im Kkeokjeong flew more than ten meters
findings.defect: 십여 미터 is about ten meters, not more than ten.
findings.rationale: 여 marks an approximate ten, not a distance beyond ten.

summary: Specific address of Im as 꺽정 형님 is dropped twice; the greatsword fake-out is recast as hypothetical; 전승 is flattened to a completed transfer.
